in_marathi.name: Atmaja
in_marathi.long_meaning: Atmaja हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Atma’ meaning ‘self’ and ‘Ja’ meaning ‘born’. In Hindu mythology, Atmaja is the name given to the divine child who is self-born or self-realized.

in_bengali.name: Atmaja
in_bengali.long_meaning: Atmaja একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Atma’ meaning ‘self’ and ‘Ja’ meaning ‘born’. In Hindu mythology, Atmaja is the name given to the divine child who is self-born or self-realized.
